title: Generic Model-Owned Temporal Certificate Transaction Seam
owner_scope: Generic transaction/runtime semantics only. No Richards or soil-water specific estimator or numerical limit is owned here.

candidate_mode.name: MODEL_OWNED_CERTIFICATE
candidate_mode.generic_acceptance: available AND finite AND indicator >= 0 AND indicator <= 1
candidate_mode.retry_semantics: On solver, temporal-certificate or hard-mass rejection, restore exact checkpoint and shorten attempt_dt using existing retry_scale.
candidate_mode.canonical_interval_semantics: An accepted shorter attempt mutates only the private canonical working state. run_canonical_interval continues until requested external t1 before kernel candidate materialization.

qualification_gates.A_static_contract: Existing mode unchanged and certificate mode generic/fail-closed.
qualification_gates.B_transaction_behavior: Synthetic model proves certificate accept, unavailable fail-closed, retry-to-shorter-certified-step, rollback isolation and independent hard-mass rejection.
qualification_gates.C_canonical_interval: Accepted shorter certified steps compose to requested t1 without exposing partial external candidate or mutating caller committed state.
qualification_gates.D_regression: Existing F-KT transaction/kernel qualification tests remain green under default mode.
